{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Water Dragon''' (壬辰, ''mizunoe tatsu''; onyomi ''jishin'') is the 29th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 29th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Metal Rabbit|ja|辛卯}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Water Snake|ja|癸巳}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''壬'' is Yang Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''辰'' (Dragon) is Yang Earth; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Years of Yang Water Dragon==
A {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year that leaves a remainder of 32 when divided by 60 is a year of Yang Water Dragon (壬辰).

That is, if a Western calendar year N (N>0) is a year of Renchin, then

<math> N - \lfloor{N/60}\rfloor * 60 = 32 </math>
Here, the symbol <math> \lfloor x \rfloor</math> denotes the {{ill|Floor and ceiling functions|ja|床関数|ja_comment=fixed jawiki redirect|3=床関数と天井関数|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q215193}}.

==Months of Yang Water Dragon==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 1 or 6 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kanoto (辛)|ja|辛|lt=Kanoto (辛)}} and {{ill|Hinoe (丙)|ja|丙|lt=Hinoe (丙)}}), the month of {{ill|March|en|March|qid=Q110|lt=March}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}} of {{ill|Yang Water Dragon|ja|壬辰}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|af|Sontermyn|ar|فصل شمسي|ast|Términos solares|cdo|Cáik-ké|cs|24 ťie-čchi|eo|Suna Periodo|es|Términos solares|fr|Période solaire|hak|Chiet-hì|he|תקופות חמה (לוח השנה הסיני)|id|Posisi matahari|ja|二十四節気|ko|절기|ms|Jieqi|ro|Termen solar|th|ภาวะ (ปฏิทินจีน)|tr|Güneş dönemi|vi|Tiết khí|wuu|節氣|za|Cietheiq|zh|节气|zh_classical|節氣|zh_min_nan|Cheh-khùi|zh_yue|節氣|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|en|Qingming (solar term)|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming}} until the day before {{ill|Lixia|af|Lixia|cdo|Lĭk-hâ|hak|Li̍p-ha|id|Lixia|ja|立夏|ko|입하|sv|Lixia|vi|Lập hạ|wuu|立夏|za|Laebhah|zh|立夏|zh_classical|立夏|zh_min_nan|Li̍p-hā|zh_yue|立夏|qid=Q1191007|lt=Lixia}}) as applicable.
